gaps.quoted_evidence: Scientific Advisory Board members not listed despite section header present
gaps.reasoning: The team page itself has a Scientific Advisory Board section, indicating the company recognises the need for named clinical/scientific credibility, but no members are shown. The named team (CEO, Head of Electronics, Lead Research Chemist) has no visible clinical, oncology, or diagnostics-medicine background despite the product targeting cancer detection and biomarker screening.

notes_for_human: Team is very small (3 named members) and pre-revenue/seed stage, so several conventional gaps (commercial, CFO, people/talent, demand gen) are premature to flag given company size — they were excluded as not yet evidenced by the record. The strongest signals relate to the regulated, health-data-handling nature of the product outpacing the visible advisory bench. Worth directly verifying with the founders whether any of the three flagged gaps are already covered by informal advisors, since the website is sparse and may simply be behind on public disclosure (e.g. the empty SAB section header is a notable self-reported gap).
